title: Hikmat al-Ishraq (Arabic-Persian, Delhi 1920 print)
author: Shihab al-Din Suhrawardi
description: Suhrawardi's Philosophy of Illumination in the supplied Arabic-Persian edition. It explores knowledge and reality through the symbolism and metaphysics of light within a major tradition of Islamic philosophy.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/hikmatalishraq02suhr).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
